$schema_note: MMBT benchmark-bundle manifest. Read this BEFORE drawing conclusions from any data in this directory. Status vocabulary: canonical = load-bearing for the report's claims; preliminary = labeled, present, not yet conclusive; retracted = present for transparency but excluded from claims; archive = older drafts kept for history.
claim_scope: Single-user (conc=1) decode + prefill performance and chassis-class thermal behavior of two Qwen3.6 Q8 models across four hardware platforms under one pinned llama.cpp source SHA. Multi-user (conc≥4) cells are held; cross-engine / quality / cross-day variance / wider hardware sampling are explicitly out of scope (see ../NOT-HERE-YET.md).
